edits.new: Global Energy Monitor gives the Hong Kong company as 50% Huaneng Shandong Power Generation and 50% Jining Chengtou Holding Group, with Shandong Ruyi absent. That record puts no date on either holding: both shareholder rows have an empty start date and an empty end date, and the only date carried anywhere on it is 30 June 2024, shown as "first seen" and "last change" on the OpenSanctions mirror, which is when the record entered that mirror rather than when the shareholding began. Global Energy Monitor's own Sahiwal plant page does not match its ownership record: it names Huaneng Shandong Electricity and Shandong Ruyi Group as the sponsors and China Huaneng Group and Shandong Ruyi Group as the parent companies, gives no percentages, and does not mention Jining Chengtou at all. NEPRA's tariff decision names no shareholders.
